crossRefs.note: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.
The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven…
The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in…

translations.web: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
translations.bsb: He lies under the lotus plants, hidden among the reeds of the marsh.
translations.kjv: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
translations.asv: He lieth under the lotus-trees, In the covert of the reed, and the fen.
